content: Cadsarana jistama cayashcagunamanda
Jesus shuc cuintanata yachachingahua casna nisha cuintara,
Diospa ali mandanaga shuc jatun mandac runa caicuinta ricuric man. Chi runaga paihua churi cadsarana jistata rara.
Ñáa tucuita alichishcahuasha paihua runagunata cachara tucui cayashcagunata micuc shamunauchun nisha rimangahua. Randi chi cayashca runagunaga mana shamunata munanaurachu.

Cutillata shuccunatas cachara casna nisha, Tucui cayashca runagunata rimagrichi, ña micunatas tucuita rashcami, huira huagratas ovejagunatas huanchirani, tucuitas huin yanushcata charini, cunan ñuca churi cadsarana jistama gustangahua shamuichi.
Chasna rimagllaita chi cayashca runagunaga mana uyanaurachu. Maicangunaga chagrama rinaura, maicangunaga paiguna tarabanama rinaura.
Maicangunaga amu cachashca runagunata japisha paigunata piñasha sagmasha huanchinaura.
Ñáa chita amu uyasha yapa mana cáillata piñarira, paihua sundalugunata cachara chi piñac runagunatas huanchigrichi, paiguna llactatas rupachigrichi nisha.
Chihuasha paihua runagunata nira, Cadsarana jista micuna ña yanushca man, randi chi cayashcaguna mana balicchanaun caibi angahua.
Cunan ñambita richi, tucui chibi tupashca runagunata pushamuichi.
Chasna nishcata uyasha tucui tupashca runagunata apamunaura, ali runagunatas chasnallata mana ali runagunatahuas. Chasna apamucpi chi jista micuna huasi jundarira.
Chihuasha amu chi shamushcagunata saludangahua yaicusha, shuc runata ricura cadsarana jista churarina illac aucta.
Ricusha paita tapura, Imangahuata cadsaranaraicu shuc cushca llachapata mana churarisha yaicurangui alá. Chasna tapucpi chunlla tucusha shayarira.

Mana imatahuas rimanata ushacpi chi amu paihua runagunata mandara, Cai runata paihua chaquitas maquitas huatasha canzhama shitaichi mana cáilla ansa ucuma. Chibi huacanas tucui tunu sinzhi nanai tiyashcama tucsigrichi nisha mandara.
Ashca runaguna cayashca manaun, astahuanbas ashilla runaguna anllashca tucunaunga.
Gubirnuma cullquita paganamanda
Jesus chasna yachachiuta uyasha fariseoguna rinaura paigunapura cuintanacungahua imasna nishata Jesusta pandachishun japingahuaca nisha ninaura.

Chasna yuyaricpi paiguna quiquin japishca runagunatas, mandac amu Herodespa runagunatahuas Jesuspagma cachanaura paita tapungahua casna nisha, Can sirtu rimac ashcata yachanchi señor. Pitas mana manzhasha Dios munashcashina causana partimanda yachachingui. Tucui runagunata pariu chi tupullata yuyaringui.
Chasna acpi canda tapunchi, Ñáucanchita mandauc romano gubirnu mandashca cullquitaga paima paganata balinzhu, manachu balin. Imatata ningui.
Chasna tapucpi Jesus paiguna mana ali yuyaihuan tapucta yachasha paigunata nira, Llullaccuna, imangahuata camasha ñucata pandachisha nihuanguichi.
Gubirnuma pagana cullquita ricuchihuaichi, nisha mandacpi shuc cullquita apamusha ricuchinaura.
Chita apamucpi Jesus paigunata tapura, Pihuactan chibi auc ñahuiga, chibi quillcashca shutihuas pihuactan.
Tapucpi cutipanaura, Romano jatun mandac amuhuac. Chasna nicpi Jesus nira, Amuhuacta amuma cuichi, Diospactaga Diosma cuichi.
Paiguna Jesus chasna rimashcata uyasha manzharisha Jesusta saquisha rinaura.
Causarinamanda Jesusta tapushcamanda

Chi punzhallaita israel muntunmanda maican saduceoguna Jesushuan cuintanacungahua shamunaura. Paigunaga huañushcahuasha cuti causarinaga mana tiyanzhu nic manaura. Chasna acpi Jesusta casna rimanaura,

Señor, Moisesmi ñaupa uras casna nira: Punda huauqui shuc huarmita japisha huahua illac huañucpi paimanda quipa huauquiga chi huaccha huarmihuan japinacunauchun nisha. Paiguna tupashca huahuata chi punda huañuc huauquihua allpa ima chingarichun nisha paihua shutita churanaunchun. Chasna Moises mandashcami.

Cunan ñucanchi cuintangaraushcata alita uyasha rimai. Ñáucanchihuacpi canzhis (7) huauquipura causanaura. Punda huauqui shuc huarmita japira, randi huasha, huahua illac huañura. Huahua illac huañucpi, paihua quipa huauqui chi huaccha huarmihuan japinacunaura.
Ñáa paihuas huahua illac huañura. Tucui chi canzhis huauquipura chi huaccha huarmillata japishahuas huahuas illac huañunaura.
Chi tucuiguna huañushcahuasha huarmihuas huañura.

Ñáa causarina punzhaiga chi huarmiga pihua huarmitanga, canzhis huauquipura paihuan japishca acpi. Chasna tucucpimi huañushcaguna mana cuti causaringaraushcataga ricuchin ninaura. Chasna tapusha Jesusta pandachinata munasha tapunaura.
Jesus chita uyasha casna cutipasha rimara, Canguna pandaunguichimi Moises quillcashcagunata mana alita yachasha, Diospa ushaitas mana ricsisha pandaunguichi.
Huañushcaguna causarishcahuasha carigunas huarmigunas mana japinacunaungachu, jahuapachaibi tiyac angelguna caushcacuinta tucungaunami.
Huañushcaguna causarinamanda quiquin Dios rimashcataga manachu ricushcanguichi casna nishcata:

Ñáuca Abrahanba, Isaacpa, Jacobopa Dios mani. Dios chasna nicpi pai mana huañushcagunahua Dioschan, astahuanbas causaccunahua Dios man. Chasna acpi Abrahan, Isaac, Jacobopas causaucuna ashcata ricuchinmi.
Tucui runaguna Jesus chasna yachachishcata uyasha manzharinaura.
Mas balic mandashca shimimanda
Jesus chasna yuyaihuan yachachicpi saduceoguna pingarisha chunlla tucunaura. Chasna tucushcata uyasha fariseoguna tandarisha, Jesuspagma shamunaura.
Paigunamanda shucca Moises mandashcagunata yachachic acca Jesusta pandachisha nisha camasha tapura,
Dios mandashcagunamanda maicanda mas yali balic an señor.
Tapucpi cutipara:

content.text: Camba amu Diosta tucui camba shunguhuan, tucui camba almahuan, tucui camba yuyaihuan llaquina mangui.

content: Chimi punda mas balic mandashca shimi an.
Chimandahuasha chi cuintallata man casna nisha:

content.text: Camba quiquin aichata llaquishcacuintallata shuccunatahuas llaquina mangui.

content: Dios tucui mandashcagunai, tucui pai rimashcata pasachiccuna rimashcai chi ishcai shimimandami rimashca tiyan.
Cristoga pihua churi tan nisha tapushcamanda
Fariseoguna chara tandarishca anaupi Jesus paigunata tapura,
Imasata yuyaringuichi quishpichic Cristomanda. Pimanda mirai runatan. Tapucpi cutipanaura casna nisha, Israelgunata mandac rey amu Davidmanda mirai man.

Rimanaupi paigunata tapura, Imasata israelgunata mandac rey amu Davidga Diospa Samai paita yuyachicpi, quispichic Cristotaga ñucata mandac, señor mangui nisha rimara. Davidllatami casna quillcasha saquira:

content.text: Jatun amu Diosca ñucata mandactami rimara casna nisha,
Ñáuca ali maqui partima tiyari ñuca tucui canda piñaccunatas binsinagama.

content: Huañuc Davidllata Cristota amu nisha rimacpiga imasata Cristoga Davidba miraimanda churi angaya.
Tapucpi pihuas paita cutipanata mana ushanaurachu. Chasna acpi chi punzhamandapacha Jesusta pandachingahua imatas tapunatas saquinaura.
